description: This file defines storage interfaces, configuration structures, and a factory for creating storage backends (local or PostgreSQL) in a Go project related to agent control plane data storage.

classes.name: RunSummaryAggregation
classes.description: Holds aggregated statistics for a single workflow run.

classes.name: StorageProvider
classes.description: Interface for primary data storage backend, including methods for managing executions, workflows, webhooks, agents, DIDs, VC, and observability features.

classes.name: CacheProvider
classes.description: Interface for high-performance caching layer with pub/sub capabilities.

classes.name: StorageConfig
classes.description: Configuration structure for storage backend, supporting local, PostgreSQL, and vector store options.

classes.name: VectorStoreConfig
classes.description: Controls vector storage behavior, including enabling/disabling and distance metric.

classes.name: StorageFactory
classes.description: Factory class responsible for creating storage and cache providers based on configuration.

methods.name: CreateStorage
methods.description: Creates and initializes storage and cache providers based on configuration, supporting local and PostgreSQL modes.
